title: Discuss: XRPL v1.4.0 Alpha Release
key_points: XRPL Foundation is seeking feedback on the alpha release of XRPL v1.4.0.
The update includes several new features and improvements to the protocol.
Community input will be used to refine the changes before the official release.
limitations: This discussion is part of an open-source project, so the quality and accuracy of information can vary.
asserts: The XRPL Foundation is looking for community feedback on the alpha release of version 1.4.0 to help improve the protocol.
